messages:
Rafi (partnerships): Heads-up: prepping a short decision doc for marketplace private-offers + renewal cliff policy. Want input on rebates vs. upfront credits.
Nina (sales): Why not both? Small rebate at renewal + SI enablement credit up-front. Helps cashflow for partners.
Omar (finance): Careful: rebates create deferred revenue impact. Upfront credits are cleaner but we need strict vesting triggers.
Lena (marketplace): Also remember cloud marketplaces often treat private-offer discounts as on-invoice adjustments. That affects how we report gross vs net.
Tom (eng-ops): Technical ask: if private offer adjusts SKU price, entitlements need mapping to seat tokens for usage metering. That's a dependency.
Rafi (partnerships): Draft proposal concept: 3x models - credit-first, rebate-first, hybrid. Add an "expiring cliff" option: higher discount in yr1, step-down in yr2 unless committed.
Nina (sales): Example: 30% yr1 credit (paid on invoice), 10% automatic renewal discount year2 if commit maintained, otherwise reverts to list.
Omar (finance): We need numbers. Provide P&L sensitivity: churn scenarios, revenue deferral, and break-even token volume for each model. I'll run a quick sim.
Lena (marketplace): Cloud note: some marketplaces disallow promotional credits passed as third-party payments. If credit shows as invoice reduction, it's OK; if it's a partner rebate outside the marketplace, check tax implications.
Tom (eng-ops): Who owns SKU mapping build? We need a ticket for entitlements + SKU metadata for private offers. @eng-ops please advise timeline.
contracts-bot: New task CT-778 created: prepare SKU entitlement mapping for private-offer launch.
Rafi (partnerships): Legal/contract condition: credits tied to proof of usage and proof of net new ARR. Also propose a 90-day audit right for credits >$75k.
Nina (sales): For SIs: propose co-sell margin 12% on net new ARR + enablement credit 10% (capped). Differentiate MSP vs integrator deals.
Omar (finance): Flag: any effective total discount >22% on a public SKU after marketplace fee requires FP&A + VP sign-off. Add approval gate to playbook.
Lena (marketplace): Operational: add a marketplace checklist: tax jurisdiction, minimum term restrictions, who can accept private offers, and whether cloud takes cut on the private discount.
Rafi (partnerships): I'll add renewal cliff language: if customer fails to renew 30 days pre-expiry, discount steps down by X; if renewed within 30 days, keep original tier. We can tweak timing.
Tom (eng-ops): Also add telemetry: mark offers with metadata to track usage vs commit automatically for renewal alerts.
Nina (sales): Quick ask: can we allow a small "trial top-up" credit for marketplace conversions to avoid friction on migration from trial to private-offer?
Omar (finance): Trial credits need clear attribution rules or they'll mess up pipelines. If we do it, cap at $5k and require sales justification.
Rafi (partnerships): OK action items: 1) Omar to run P&L sims, 2) Tom to open SKU mapping ticket CT-778, 3) Lena to draft marketplace compliance checklist, 4) Nina to provide SI differentiation examples, 5) contracts-bot to draft audit clause. Sync Friday 10am PT?
Lena (marketplace): Works for me.
Nina (sales): Works.
Omar (finance): Works.
Tom (eng-ops): :thumbsup: I'll start CT-778 and ping eng-ops.
Rafi (partnerships): Thanks all  I'll assemble one-pager and a sample private-offer term sheet. Posting before EOD tomorrow.
